prompt: Please provide a comprehensive analysis of every scene, character dialogue, and plot development of the entire Harry Potter book series.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 explicitly provides only “a high-level overview of each book” rather than an analysis of every scene/character dialogue across the entire series, but it at least covers all seven books and stays broadly on-topic. Candidate 2 includes major fabricated/hallucinated specifics (e.g., “Chapter 1: ‘Harry Potter’ (2004)” and a “Quidditch match against the Death Eaters,” plus other incorrect scene/chapter framing), making it the weakest despite being formatted like a study. Candidate 3 offers more scene/dialogue-style analysis for books 1–3 but is largely incomplete (“Book 4… Scene Analysis: 1” and then stops), so it fails the “entire series” requirement. Candidate 4 focuses narrowly on Chapter 1 of Book 1 only, so it has very low coverage of the requested scope even though its details are generally plausible.
